events.title: Avanos Medical (AVNS) Lags Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Avanos Medical (AVNS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -4.35% and +7.61%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: InspireMD, Inc. (NSPR) Reports Q1 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
events.body: InspireMD (NSPR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +15.79% and +25.85%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Avanos Stock Surged on $1.27 Billion AIP Buyout Deal at 72% Premium
events.body: AVNS stock jumps after agreeing to a $1.27B all-cash buyout by AIP at a 72% premium, offering shareholders immediate value and setting up a private-market shift.

events.title: AIP to acquire Avanos Medical for $1.27bn
events.body: After closing, Avanos will be private in Alpharetta, Georgia, and delist its shares from the NYSE.
